<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">The Problem</h2><a id="user-content-the-problem" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: The Problem" href="#the-problem"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Claude Code started hiding what it does.</strong></p>
<p dir="auto">Since <a href="https://symmetrybreak.ing/blog/claude-code-is-being-dumbed-down/" rel="nofollow">v2.1.20</a>, Claude Code replaced detailed output with opaque summaries. <code>Read 3 files</code>. <code>Searched for 1 pattern</code>. <code>Edited 2 files</code>. No file paths. No content. No line numbers. The <a href="https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46978710" rel="nofollow">community backlash was immediate</a>.</p>
<p dir="auto">But the problem goes deeper than collapsed file paths:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Thinking steps</strong> — Claude's chain-of-thought reasoning is completely invisible in the terminal</li>
<li><strong>Tool call details</strong> — you see a one-line summary, not the actual input/output</li>
<li><strong>Subagent activity</strong> — agents spawn agents, but you only see the final result</li>
<li><strong>Context window</strong> — a three-segment progress bar with no breakdown of what's consuming your tokens</li>
<li><strong>Team coordination</strong> — teammate messages, task delegation, shutdown requests — all buried</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">The only workaround is <code>--verbose</code>, which dumps raw JSON, internal system prompts, and thousands of lines of noise. <strong>There is no middle ground.</strong></p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">The Solution</h2><a id="user-content-the-solution" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: The Solution" href="#the-solution"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>claude-devtools is the debugging tool for Claude Code.</strong> It reads the Claude Code logs and session transcripts already saved to <code>~/.claude/</code> on your machine, and reconstructs <em>everything</em>.</p>
